sloka: ताम् शून्य शृन्ग अटक वेश्म रथ्याम् ।रजो अरुण द्वार कपाट यन्त्राम् ।दृष्ट्वा पुरीम् इन्द्र पुरी प्रकाशाम् ।दुह्खेन सम्पूर्णतरः बभूव ॥२-७१-४६॥
transliteration: tām śūnya śṛnga aṭaka veśma rathyām ।rajo aruṇa dvāra kapāṭa yantrām ।dṛṣṭvā purīm indra purī prakāśām ।duhkhena sampūrṇataraḥ babhūva ॥2-71-46॥

translations.english: ﻿ As he (Bharata) beheld the city of Ayodhya that once had the lustre of the city of Indra, now with its crossroads, houses and highways all deserted, the fittings (nuts and bolts) on the doors red with dust, he was overwhelmed with grief.
